narrative:
## Handover Summary — Market Access

Access assumptions are confirmed by brand-indication and market.

## Key Decisions
• Ultomiris gMG blended access raised on Italy and Spain reimbursement outlook
• Koselugo China access lifted after the NRDL listing
• Emerging Markets aHUS held pending tender cycles

## Recommendation for Pricing & GTN
The Pricing Lead should net the access gains against JCA-driven European price pressure, and against US Medicaid and 340B mix shifts.
